bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for the WonderTrek Children's Museum in the city of Baxter.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+WONDERTREK CHILDREN'S MUSEUM; APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$2,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to WonderTrek Children's Museum, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to design, construct, equip, and furnish capital improvements to phase I of a nine-acre children's museum campus in the city of Baxter. This appropriation includes money for site improvements, infrastructure, landscaping, a 2,400 square foot year-round indoor-outdoor classroom, four acres of nature play exhibits and environments, and outdoor recreation activities and education. This appropriation is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. This is a onetime appropriation. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for the WonderTrek Children's Museum in the city of Baxter.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. WONDERTREK CHILDREN'S MUSEUM; APPROPRIATION.

$2,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to WonderTrek Children's Museum, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to design, construct, equip, and furnish capital improvements to phase I of a nine-acre children's museum campus in the city of Baxter. This appropriation includes money for site improvements, infrastructure, landscaping, a 2,400 square foot year-round indoor-outdoor classroom, four acres of nature play exhibits and environments, and outdoor recreation activities and education. This appropriation is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. This is a onetime appropriation.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.

This appropriation includes money for site improvements, infrastructure, landscaping, a 2,400 square foot year-round indoor-outdoor classroom, four acres of nature play exhibits and environments, and outdoor recreation activities and education. This appropriation is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. This is a onetime appropriation.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
